summary: The change adds the applicant's raw SSN, loanCase.applicantField("ssn"), unmasked to an info-level log line on every credit decline. This directly violates LOG-1. No approved exception covers it: EXC-0167 is limited to masked bank-account last-4 in a legacy import job. The ticket and the independent code review are otherwise in order. Separately, the CI JUnit reports come from a local workstation and are dated after the review time, so they do not establish testing on the final commit. The change is rejected; the decline log should use Mask.npi or a non-NPI case or applicant reference.
